===Pokémon===
====Gives to the player====
Professor Laventon gives the player their choice of [[first partner Pokémon]] from Pokémon he collected while traveling the {{pkmn|world}}. After the player has beaten the main story of Pokémon Legends: Arceus, he will give the player the remaining two first partner Pokémon once spoken to at his lab.
